# Lacuna

> Temporal, provenance-first memory for AI agents. Lacuna tracks corrections,
> preserves evidence, exposes unresolved conflicts and abstains when history
> cannot support an answer.

## Canonical links

- Product: https://lacuna-five.vercel.app/
- Public workspace: https://lacuna-five.vercel.app/explore
- Judge view: https://lacuna-five.vercel.app/judge
- Source: https://github.com/vaibhav4046/lacuna
- Current evidence: https://github.com/vaibhav4046/lacuna/blob/main/docs/EVIDENCE_INDEX.md
- Release boundary: https://github.com/vaibhav4046/lacuna/blob/main/docs/V10_RELEASE_STATUS.md
- MCP setup: https://github.com/vaibhav4046/lacuna/blob/main/docs/CONNECT_CLIENTS.md
- LongMemEval scope: https://github.com/vaibhav4046/lacuna/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARK_LONGMEMEVAL.md

## Important limits

- The extractor reads bounded sentence frames, not arbitrary English.
- The generated 64-question evaluation is not an official LongMemEval score.
- The public workspace is read-only.
- HydraDB Cloud and self-hosted graph adapters are separate execution boundaries.
